blockers.detail: Absolute /root/cj_build/agent_scratch path cannot import packaged capture.py on official runner; owner must make it relocatable.
-S commands run capture.arm before platform/target create; capture.arm raises no target. Owner must establish target before arming.
realIO returns host adb child.pid for background server; cleanup uses this as Android PID. Need actual device server PID and owned cleanup, timeout/total limit and final child reaping.

Real launch stdout/stderr are discarded, no fatal/association decoded, nonzero launch rc becomes NOT_REPRODUCED. Need native status, PID/window, raw capture and UNKNOWN on missing evidence; consume existing 761b observer where applicable.
Launch does not set device LD_LIBRARY_PATH; target/symbol paths need local-vs-remote binding and verified loaded runtime. Actual LLDB/server versions/platform list still NOT_VERIFIED.
Init/destroy records contain PC/module but no destroyer stack. Need same-execution generation and both stacks/modules; do not infer association from historical register/address.
